dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Oh Ashru, my dear Ashru, come, lend me your claws for a minute. I need to open this letter.

dialogues.speaker: Ashru
dialogues.text: Meow meow, meow meow meow meow...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: *Sigh* I was just joking. And, speaking of which, it looks like your claws are overdue for a clipping...?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Alright, it's decided. I'll do it right now. Stay here while I get the nail clippers.
